data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to copy sensitive content to clipboard, hiding it on Android 13.
data.what_it_does: Wraps the default clipboard and uses Android 13's sensitive flag to prevent the copied text from being shown in the system UI. On iOS it falls back to the standard clipboard behavior.
use_when: You need to copy confidential data on Android 13 without showing it in the pop‑up notification
You want a simple API to hide sensitive clipboard content across Android and iOS
avoid_when: Targeting only older Android versions where the flag is unnecessary
You need full clipboard management (e.g., rich content, multiple formats)
strengths: Works on both Android and iOS
weaknesses: Only supports copy (paste support added later but limited)
data.setup_notes: Set compileSdkVersion to 33 in android/app/build.gradle; no additional permissions required.
